name: lab4
description: 1. Create project folder 2. right click on project folder and select open integrated terminal 3. type in terminal `npm init -y` press enter open package.json file from project folder 4. update type as `module` in package.json 5. type in terminal `npm i nodemon -D` to install nodemon, which restarts server while file changes. -D flag indicate install in dev dependency. 6. it creates node_modules folder and package-lock.json
